adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for deleteEvent around line 312-315, the code changes from `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` to `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When externalCalendarId is falsy/undefined (legacy case), the find() will never match anything (comparing undefined === undefined might work, but the intent seems wrong), so calendarId becomes undefined, falling back to defaultCalendarId which is 'primary'. This is a logic error - the original code would use the destination calendar's externalId as fallback, but now it incorrectly falls back to 'primary' when there's no externalCalendarId provided. This could cause events to be deleted from the wrong calendar or fail to delete from the correct one.
